text:
Accepted as version 1: 19 layer(s).
Quick check of version 1 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Differences (canvas px, x right / y down, s):

1. **Content-block outline** — yours draws a thin red/dark stroke around the bars+button group from ~1.33 s to 3.30 s (≈x 105–255, y 150–260). Target has no stroke anywhere: bars and button are flat, borderless shapes.
2. **Blue button** — yours pops it in at 1.97 s at ~half width (≈x 150–215, y 235–250) and widens later. Target first shows it at 2.20 s already full width (≈x 95–265, y 245–262) and slightly lower/thicker.
3. **Bar row timing/size** — yours turns the top bar dark at ~1.53 s and keeps the two dark bars narrow and high (≈x 120–240, y 155–190). Target keeps a short light-gray bar until 1.77 s, then swaps to wider dark bars (≈x 105–255, y 165–200).

Minor: card scale-up finishes ~0.43 s in yours vs ~0.55 s in target, and yours' 0.67 s green dot is ~20 % smaller.
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 2: 19 layer(s).
Quick check of version 2 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
"yours" is a mixed bag: the too-early blue button is fixed, but the card-in and confetti regressed — roughly a wash, slightly better. CHANGE: better

- Card scale-in, 0.23–0.43s: yours' card is still small (~x 130–280, y 130–260) at 0.23s; target's card is already nearly full-frame (~x 45–315, y 50–310) by 0.23s and shows a green speck at 0.43s.
- Confetti, 0.87–1.53s: yours starts the burst late (first dots 1.10s, none at 0.87s) and still has dots at 1.33s and 1.53s; target bursts 0.87–1.10s (~x 120–240, y 35–90) and is clean from 1.33s on.
- Blue button, 2.20s: yours' button is only ~40% of card width (~x 130–230) and goes full ~2.43s; target is already ~60% (~x 100–260) at 2.20s, full by 2.43s.
- Text rows, 1.77–3.30s: yours' gray placeholder lines are slightly narrower/shorter than target's, leaving the lower card area emptier around y 250–300.

Accepted as version 3: 19 layer(s).
Quick check of version 3 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
yours is closer to the target than previous — the disc now scales in and the bottom blue bar now appears in the right window, but the checkmark still lands too early. CHANGE: better

1. Green disc + check — 0.6–0.9s: yours draws the white check at 0.67s; the target is still a plain solid green disc at 0.67s and only shows the check at 0.87s (check ~0.2s early).
2. Bottom blue bar — 1.8–2.3s: at 1.97s the target bar is already near full card width (~center x 180, y 305); yours is only a small blue stub at 1.97s and reaches full width at ~2.2s (grows too slowly / fills late).
3. Disc scale-in — 0.40–0.50s: at 0.43s the target is a barely visible ~2px dot at card center; yours is already a distinct ~8–10px green circle (starts too large / grows too fast).

Accepted as version 4: 19 layer(s).
Quick check of version 4 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Yours is closer to the target than previous overall — the 0.67s plain green disc now matches (previous drew the checkmark ~0.2s early) and previous's stray blue fragments at 1.33s/1.97s are gone; from 0.87s on the card, badge, confetti and skeleton track the target closely. CHANGE: better

1. Badge grow-in, 0.40–0.60s: yours is empty at 0.43s; target shows a ~12px green dot near (180,155) that grows into the ~75px disc by 0.67s (previous had a dot but ~2× too big and too high).
2. Card height, 0.87–1.53s: yours' card reads ~8–10% taller than target's at the same times, so badge, skeleton lines and the bottom edge all sit a few px low; target's card grows more slowly.
3. Blue bar, ~1.77s: target's bar is only ~65% of the card width and fills to full by ~2.2s; yours already looks full width at 1.77s.
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 5: 19 layer(s).
Quick check of version 5 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
yours is closer to the target than previous — the 0.43s dot, the 1.10s two-bar state, and the 1.97s+ blue bar all track target while previous misses them. CHANGE: better

- Confetti burst, 1.10–1.33s: yours throws only ~4 dots hugging the check icon (≈175,120) and is fully clear by 1.33s; target scatters 7–8 green/yellow/red dots out to x≈115–255, y≈75–140 and still holds 2 faint dots at 1.33s.
- Blue progress bar, 1.97–2.63s: yours is already full card width (x≈78–282, y≈255) at 2.43s; target is ~60% at 1.97s, ~78% at 2.20s, ~90% at 2.43s and only reaches full width at 2.63s.
- Placeholder card, 0.23s: yours' grey rounded rect is larger and lighter (≈x85–275, y95–265); target's is smaller/darker (≈x105–255, y110–250) and dims a step earlier.
- Grey text lines, 1.53–1.77s: yours shows the third light-grey line already at 1.53s; target holds 2 grey + 1 light line until 1.77s, then adds the second light line.
- Green disc, 0.67s: yours' disc is ~1.1× target's radius (≈19px vs ≈17px) and lands at the same centre, so it reads slightly heavy before the check appears.

Accepted as version 6: 19 layer(s).
Quick check of version 6 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Yours is slightly further from the target than previous — the check/bar phase still matches, but the bottom blue bar now starts later and grows slower than in previous, and the early placeholder square is still too dark. CHANGE: worse

1. Blue progress bar — 1.9–2.9 s: target already has a ~40%-wide bar at 1.97 s (x≈100–260, y≈265–280) and full width by ≈2.6 s; yours has none at 1.97 s, is ~30% narrower at 2.2–2.6 s, and only fills at ≈2.9 s (~0.25 s late).
2. Placeholder square opacity — 0.2–0.5 s: at 0.23 s the target's rounded square is barely visible (≈#F2F2F2, x≈95–265, y≈55–150); yours draws it clearly gray (≈#E6E6E6), i.e. the fade-in runs ~0.2 s ahead.
3. Confetti burst — 1.0–1.25 s: target sprays many colored dots widely above the card (x≈120–320, y≈10–75); yours keeps a smaller, tighter cluster (x≈150–280, y≈25–60), so the burst reads weaker.

Accepted as version 7: 19 layer(s).
Quick check of version 7 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
"yours" is slightly closer to the target than "previous" — the blue button now appears earlier and widens sooner, matching the target's faster grow-in; the confetti spread and the body-text density are still about where they were. CHANGE: better

- Confetti burst (1.10–1.53s): target throws ~12 particles across x≈90–270, y≈55–135 that have faded out by ~1.45s; yours shows only ~6 small dots clustered right above the check (x≈140–220, y≈70–110), with a few still visible at 1.53s.
- Body text block (1.33–3.30s): target reveals 4 gray lines at y≈205–258 (widths ≈200/170/190/120 px) as the card fills; yours shows only 3 shorter lines that start later, so the lower card stays emptier.
- Blue button growth (1.77–2.63s): target's pill is already ≈40% of card width at 1.77s (x≈60–150) and near-full by 2.43s; yours is only a ~15% nub at 1.77s and does not reach full width until ~2.87s.
- Check icon (0.67–1.33s): target's disc is ~60 px diameter centered near (180, 115) and shifts up to y≈100 as confetti fires; yours stays slightly smaller and lower throughout.

Accepted as version 8: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 8 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
**Yours is a bit further from the target than previous** — the second half improved slightly (button fill starts ~0.2 s earlier and the fill wipe is smoother), but the whole pop/check phase now lags the target by ~0.25 s, which previous had matched. CHANGE: worse

- **Confetti burst** — yours 1.10–1.77 s: only a few faint dots at 1.10 s, gone by 1.33 s; target fires ~12 bright multi-color particles spanning x≈110–250, y≈75–180 and keeps them visible through ~1.77 s.
- **Circle→checkmark pop timing** — yours 0.43–1.33 s: still a tiny dot at 0.87 s and the check only reads at 1.10 s; target has a large green disc (center ≈180,125, r≈40) at 0.67 s and the white check inside it by 0.87 s.
- **Card fade-in** — yours 0.23 s: cell is blank, card only appears at 0.43 s; target already shows a faint card (x≈55–305, y≈45–330) at 0.23 s.
- **Bottom button** — yours 1.77–2.63 s: no button at all at 1.77 s and the blue fill only reaches full width at ~2.87 s; target shows the pill (x≈90–270, y≈265–300) already blue at 1.77–1.97 s.
Preview (target | yours | difference heat map: black = same, bright = different).

Accepted as version 9: 27 layer(s).
Automatic full review 1 (the checker compared filmstrips and motion curves of the target and your version 9):
1. **Blue bottom bar (blue underline)** — target grows it from the **left edge** starting ≈1.83 s, reaching full card width (x ≈85→275, y ≈215-228) by ≈2.10 s. Yours first shows blue at ≈1.90 s as a **short bar near the centre/right** (x ≈170-230) and it stays short through 2.17-2.47 s, only matching the target's full width around ≈2.60 s. So yours is late, anchored in the wrong place and grows far too slowly.

2. **Green circle — size and vertical position** — target's circle is already ≈80 px across at 0.50-0.57 s (centre ≈(175, 100)); yours is only ≈55 px across at those times and catches up ≈0.10 s later (0.63-0.70 s). Its size curve also overshoots strongly in the target (spike at ≈0.7-0.9 s) while yours' peak is much smaller, and yours settles at a slightly smaller size and a few px higher (curve y ≈112 vs target ≈122).

3. **White check mark inside the circle** — target's check is drawn by ≈0.70 s and complete at 0.77 s; yours still shows a plain green circle at 0.70-0.77 s and only reveals the check at ≈0.83 s. About 0.10 s late.

4. **Thick black bar (dark navy)** — target's placeholder bar turns into the full-width black bar at ≈1.47 s, spanning x ≈85-275 at ≈14 px thick; yours turns black later (≈1.53-1.60 s) and stays **narrower and thinner** through 1.47-1.77 s (its dark-navy visible-size curve sits well below the target's).

5. **Grey placeholder bar + the two text lines (1.13-1.40 s)** — target's grey bar reaches full card width by ≈1.33 s and the two grey lines under it are visible from ≈1.20 s; yours' grey bar is narrower/lighter and its text lines appear later and thinner (still faint at 1.27-1.33 s).

6. **Confetti/sparkles around the check** — target's sparkles pop from ≈0.83 s; yours starts them at ≈0.90-0.97 s, slightly late and initially smaller/fewer.

7. **Light card (rounded square)** — target's card is essentially full size by 0.20-0.27 s; yours is slightly smaller/narrower at 0.13-0.37 s and only catches up ≈0.37 s (curve: target reaches full size ≈0.6 s, yours ≈0.7 s).

8. **Green dot onset (0.37-0.43 s)** — target still shows only a tiny dark dot at 0.43 s; yours already shows a distinctly green dot at 0.43 s, i.e. the circle's colour/scale comes in slightly early before it then lags behind in size (see item 2).
The checker still sees clear differences.

Accepted as version 10: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 10 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Yours ≈ previous overall: the card, circle, check and confetti beats are essentially unchanged, the only visible regression is the lost seed dot at 0.43s, and I see no clear gain to offset it. CHANGE: same

1) Circle pop-in, 0.43–0.67s — at 0.43s yours' card is empty; target shows a tiny green seed (~3 px at x≈178, y≈150) that then grows, and by 0.67s target's disc (center ≈180,165, r≈38 px) is noticeably larger than yours' (r≈30 px).
2) Blue button, 1.97–2.43s — target's pill is already full card width (x≈100–260, y≈252–276) at 2.20s; yours is still ~55–60% wide (ends x≈190) at 2.20s and only fills at 2.43s, so the grow-in is ~0.2s late.
3) Card content fade, 1.10–1.33s — target's bars/text are still fading in (top bar mid-gray at 1.10s, second bar arriving ~1.33s); yours already shows a full-dark bar and a near-complete text stack at 1.10s.
Coordinates are eyeballed from the 3×-downscaled filmstrip cells, so treat the pixel figures as approximate.

Accepted as version 11: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 11 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
**Yours is closer to the target than previous** — the 0.43s badge dot, the 0.67s plain green disc (previous already showed the check) and the lighter card fade-in now match, and the confetti is closer; the regression is the CTA button, which now starts and finishes early. CHANGE: better

- **CTA button, 1.77–2.43s**: yours already shows a small blue chip at the card's bottom-left (~x 105, y 270) at 1.77s and the bar is full width by 2.20s; target has no button at 1.77s, ~half width at 1.97s, ~75% at 2.20s and full only at ~2.43s — shift the whole grow ~0.2–0.25s later.
- **Text block reveal, 1.10–1.33s**: yours' dark header bar (~x 105–195, y ≈ 200) and the gray line under it are already longer than target's at 1.10s; target grows the bar and each gray line from short bars in staggered order, so yours' paragraph reveal runs a beat ahead.
- **Confetti, 1.10s**: yours' particles sit in a tight cluster over the badge (~x 180, y 130); target sprays smaller dots in a wider arc that reaches above the card's top edge (y < 60) and is gone by 1.33s.

Accepted as version 12: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 12 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Yours is closer than previous: the stray blue square at the card's bottom-left in "previous" (~1.77s) is gone, the text rows now match the target's dark/dark/light pattern from ~1.97s, and the button grows smoothly. CHANGE: better

- **Check disc** (0.43–0.87s): yours already has the white check inside a small disc at 0.67s (≈x145–205, y30–85); the target shows only a plain, larger disc there (≈x140–215, y20–90) and draws the check at ~0.85s — yours is ~0.2s early and ~15% small.
- **Confetti** (1.10–1.33s): yours' particles stay clustered on/above the check and a few red ones survive past 1.33s; the target's burst at 1.10s spreads wider (≈±80px around x180, y55) and is fully faded by ~1.30s.
- **Blue button** (1.77s): yours is still short (≈x120–230, y250–272); the target's already spans nearly the card's full inner width (≈x110–250, y248–272), reaching that by ~1.77s rather than ~1.97s.

Accepted as version 13: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 13 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Yours is closer to the target than previous — the oversized orange confetti blob and the extra dark bar under the check at 1.77s are both gone — but the CTA button entrance regressed. CHANGE: better

- Confetti burst (1.10–1.33s): yours' particles are ~2x too big and spread across the whole card (≈x105–255, y45–120); target keeps a tight ≈60x45 cluster hugging the check top at ≈(180, 95), only ≈x150–210, y70–115.
- Confetti fade (1.33–1.77s): yours still shows a dense, wide cloud at 1.33s; the target thins to a few faint specks by 1.33s and is fully clear by 1.53s.
- CTA button (1.77s): yours renders only a ~15px blue square at the card's bottom-left (≈x75–92, y250–265); target already shows the full rounded blue bar (≈x105–255, y215–232) centered under the text lines — yours arrives ~0.2s late and grows from the wrong corner.

Accepted as version 14: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 14 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
yours is closer to the target than previous — better: the stray blue chip at the card's bottom-left (2.20s–3.07s) and the over-thick text bars are gone, and the CTA button is now full-width from 1.97s; worse: the confetti burst at 1.10–1.33s has disappeared. CHANGE: better

1. Confetti burst — 1.10s & 1.33s, around the check (x≈150–215, y≈75–125): yours draws a bare green check; target sprays ~10 small red/yellow/green/blue particles above and beside it, still visible at 1.33s and gone by 1.53s.
2. Body text bars — 1.10s–1.53s (x≈150–215, y≈150–190): target stacks a long bar over a shorter one (gray at 1.10s, black by 1.33s) then two thin gray lines; yours renders only the top bar, so the card reads half-empty.
3. Green check disc — 0.67s–1.53s (x≈155–205, y≈130–180): target's disc is larger (~50 px) with a fat white tick; yours is a touch smaller/thinner, so the icon reads weaker than target.

Accepted as version 15: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 15 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
**CHANGE: same** — "yours" matches the target's build order (dot → circle → check → confetti → text lines → blue button) about as well as "previous"; the confetti spread is a bit closer to the target, but the bold title bar now fires even earlier, so the two roughly cancel.

- Bold title bar — 1.10–1.53 s: in "yours" the dark bar (≈x 95–205, y 178–190) is already near-black while the check is still small; the target shows only faint gray lines there and the bar reaches full darkness at ≈1.53–1.77 s (about 0.4 s late in "yours").
- Blue button — 2.20–3.30 s: "yours" pops the blue pill in at 2.20 s (≈x 95–150, y 270–292) and jumps to full width; the target has no blue until 2.43 s, then grows it steadily to ≈x 95–265 by 3.30 s.
- Confetti — 1.10–1.53 s: the target's burst spreads wide (≈x 120–250, y 60–110) and leaves stragglers visible at 1.33–1.53 s; "yours" keeps the dots clustered above the circle (≈x 165–215, y 70–100) and is clean by 1.33 s.

Accepted as version 16: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 16 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
yours is closer to target than previous: the gray halo/offset panel behind the check (visible in previous at 1.10–1.77s) is gone, and the 1.10s confetti burst now reads like the target; the blue button still arrives slightly early. CHANGE: better

1. Confetti burst — 1.10s: target scatters ~10 dots widely across ≈x 55–305, y 35–145 with orange/red mixed in; yours keeps fewer, smaller dots hugging the check (≈x 145–260, y 60–150), so the burst looks thin and late in spreading.
2. Blue button — 1.97–2.20s: yours already shows a small blue sliver at 1.97s (≈x 165–205, y 265–285); target is empty there and pops a full-width pill only at 2.20s (≈x 105–250, y 265–290).
3. Card placeholder — 0.23–0.43s: target's light-gray rounded card (≈x 110–250, y 30–300) is clearly visible at 0.23s and shrinks to a single tiny dot at 0.43s; yours renders it fainter/smaller at 0.23s, so the fade-in reads weaker.

Accepted as version 17: 27 layer(s).
Automatic full review 2 (the checker compared filmstrips and motion curves of the target and your version 17):
**Visible differences (most important first)**

1. **Green circle — size / appearance time.** Centre ≈ (180, 155). 0.47–0.85 s. Yours is already a full circle of ~34 px diameter at 0.50 s and stays that size. Target shows only a ~6 px dot at 0.50 s, growing to ~28–30 px by 0.60 s. Yours appears too early and too large.

2. **Circle → checkmark morph timing.** 0.70–0.90 s. Target's circle starts shrinking/deforming at ~0.70 s and is a complete check by 0.83 s. Yours is still a plain circle at 0.83 s (only a small notch) and only becomes a check at ~0.90 s — roughly 0.07–0.10 s late.

3. **Green checkmark size after 0.90 s.** ~(180, 155), 0.90–3.30 s. Yours' green shape is consistently a few pixels larger than the target's (the motion chart shows yours' green "visible size" above the target's for the whole clip).

4. **Content block row order.** 1.10–3.30 s, dark bar ≈ y 186–198, x 114–240. In yours a light‑gray text line is drawn *above* the dark heading bar; in the target the dark heading bar is the top row of the content block and the light lines appear only below it.

5. **Blue button fill time.** y ≈ 264–282, x ≈ 84–276. Target's bar is fully blue by 2.10 s; yours is still dark at 2.03 s, only partly blue at 2.10 s, and fully blue at 2.17 s — about one frame late.

6. **Card scale‑in speed.** 0.07–0.20 s. At 0.13 s the target's card already spans ≈ x 60–300, y 75–285, while yours is still ≈ x 90–270, y 90–270; yours catches up only by 0.20 s, so its early growth is slower.

7. **Heading bar fade‑in.** 1.07–1.27 s. Target's heading bar is still mid‑gray at 1.13 s and reaches near‑black at ~1.27 s; yours is already dark by 1.13 s.

8. **Confetti colours.** 0.97–1.20 s around (180, 130). Target's burst contains blue particles (blue curve present ~0.90–1.25 s); in yours the blue curve only starts at ~1.55 s, i.e. the blue confetti dot appears missing/smaller.
The checker still sees clear differences.

Accepted as version 18: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 18 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Yours is further from the target than previous: the early check dot and the blue CTA bar both slipped to later times, and the confetti lingers. CHANGE: worse

- Green dot, 0.43s: yours shows only the blank card; target (and previous) already show a small green dot near the card top (~x178, y120) seeding the check grow-in — yours' check effectively starts ~0.2s late.
- Blue button bar, 1.77–2.10s: target and previous show the full-width blue bar (~x120–240, y225–240) from 1.77s; yours has no blue until ~2.20s (~0.4s late).
- Confetti, 1.10–1.53s: target's burst is gone by 1.33s; yours still shows scattered colored dots around (x120–240, y90–140) at 1.33s and 1.53s (~0.3s too long).

Accepted as version 19: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 19 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Yours is closer than previous — the 0.43s dot-in and the 0.87–1.10s check-pop/confetti now line up with the target, but the CTA reveal and card anchor still drift. CHANGE: better

1. Blue CTA pill, 1.77–3.30s: yours draws it full-width and ~1.5x too tall (approx x115–245, y222–238, ~14px high) already at 1.77s; target's pill is ~8px high and wipes in from the left, reaching full width only around 2.4s.
2. Card content anchor, 1.10–3.30s: yours' check + title + body sit ~10px higher in the card (check center approx y125 vs target y135), leaving a taller gap below the body; target keeps the block vertically centered with even top/bottom margins.
3. Placeholder card, 0.23–0.43s: yours' gray rounded rect (approx x105–255, y105–255) stays at full ~15% opacity through 0.43s, so the entrance reads as a hard square; target's ghost is ~8–10% gray and has almost dissolved by 0.43s, with only the green dot remaining.

Accepted as version 20: 27 layer(s).
Quick check of version 20 by the checker (short filmstrip only):
Closer than previous — the blue button no longer appears fully at 1.77 s and the confetti is a bit less clumped — but the button bar and confetti still differ. CHANGE: better
1. Blue button bar, 1.77–2.20 s (x≈85–245, y≈455–470): yours grows a thin sliver from the left edge at 1.77 s, then keeps a bar that is thinner/lower with a faint extra rule beneath it; target shows no blue at 1.77 s and a full-width, thicker rounded bar flush in the card by 1.97 s.
2. Confetti, 1.10 s (x≈645–735): yours keeps the particles in a tight arc left of the check; target scatters them wider, above and on both sides of the check.
3. Card body text, 1.33–3.30 s (x≈85–160): yours' headline and body lines are shorter and sit lower, leaving more empty space at the card top; target's lines are longer, start higher under the check, and stop above the button.
Finished.
